title: Acacetin Attenuates Heatstroke-Induced Acute Liver Injury by Targeting the c-Jun/PTGS2 Pathway.
authors: Shu, Xiaolong; Wu, Yizhan; Chen, Yi; Song, Yuhang; Xiao, Zefa; Yuan, Hongrui; Qin, Boyi; Chai, Weihao; Huang, Kairui; Guo, Fei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Acacetin通过靶向c-Jun/PTGS2通路减轻热射病肝损伤，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但核心是药物-蛋白作用而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Heatstroke-induced acute liver injury (HS-ALI) is primarily driven by hepatic oxidative stress and inflammation. Acacetin (5,7-dihydroxy-4'-methoxyflavone, AC) is a naturally occurring O-methylated flavone derived from Chrysanthemum x morifolium (Ramat.) Hemsl., a hybrid species with the parentage C. argyrophyllum x C. dichrum x C. indicum x C. nankingense x C. zawadzkii. Known for its antioxidant, hepatoprotective, and anti-inflammatory properties, this compound has not been previously investigated for its effects on HS-ALI. This study integrated network pharmacology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulations (MDS), and in vivo experiments to evaluate the efficacy and mechanism of AC. Mice were randomized into normal control, heatstroke control, AC-pretreated (25 or 50 mg/kg/d) heatstroke groups, as well as groups treated with the c-Jun (protein symbol JUN; encoded by the Jun gene) and its N-terminal kinase activator (anisomycin) alone or in combination with AC (50 mg/kg/d). Liver injury, oxidative stress, the c-Jun and prostaglandin-endoperoxide synthase 2 (PTGS2) pathway, and ferroptosis were assessed using histopathology, western blot, and quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qPCR). Network pharmacology and molecular docking identified JUN and PTGS2 as core targets of AC, demonstrating stable binding, which was further validated by MDS. In vivo, AC pretreatment significantly alleviated histopathological damage and oxidative stress, suppressed activation of the c-Jun/PTGS2 pathway, and inhibited key markers of hepatic ferroptosis-effects that were confirmed in agonist challenge experiments. In conclusion, AC ameliorates HS-ALI likely by inhibiting the c-Jun/PTGS2 axis and attenuating ferroptosis, highlighting its potential as a candidate compound for HS-ALI.
abstract_zh: 热射病诱导的急性肝损伤（HS-ALI）主要由肝脏氧化应激和炎症驱动。金合欢素（5,7-二羟基-4'-甲氧基黄酮，AC）是一种天然存在的O-甲基化黄酮，来源于菊花（Chrysanthemum x morifolium (Ramat.) Hemsl.），该杂交种的亲本包括C. argyrophyllum x C. dichrum x C. indicum x C. nankingense x C. zawadzkii。该化合物以其抗氧化、保肝和抗炎特性而闻名，但此前尚未研究其对HS-ALI的作用。本研究整合了网络药理学、分子对接、分子动力学模拟（MDS）和体内实验，以评估AC的疗效和机制。小鼠被随机分为正常对照组、热射病对照组、AC预处理（25或50 mg/kg/d）热射病组，以及单独使用c-Jun（蛋白符号JUN；由Jun基因编码）及其N端激酶激活剂（茴香霉素）或与AC（50 mg/kg/d）联合处理的组。通过组织病理学、蛋白质印迹和定量聚合酶链反应（qPCR）评估肝损伤、氧化应激、c-Jun和前列腺素内过氧化物合酶2（PTGS2）通路以及铁死亡。网络药理学和分子对接将JUN和PTGS2鉴定为AC的核心靶点，显示出稳定的结合，这进一步通过MDS得到验证。在体内，AC预处理显著减轻了组织病理学损伤和氧化应激，抑制了c-Jun/PTGS2通路的激活，并抑制了肝铁死亡的关键标志物——这些效应在激动剂挑战实验中得到证实。总之，AC可能通过抑制c-Jun/PTGS2轴并减轻铁死亡来改善HS-ALI，突显其作为HS-ALI候选化合物的潜力。
